desktop.core_tests: 36 passed, 0 failed including packaged Windows file URL identity checks
desktop.electron_acceptance: 16 existing + 12 extended + 10 reliability checks passed, 0 failed on final runs
desktop.packaged_smoke: Exact portable EXE passed: 3 validated images, actual API execution, request idempotency, bundled script client and slow upload
desktop.upload_wait: Wait for observed HTTP writes before leaving the upload form, bounded at 45 seconds; uncertainty is not resubmitted
desktop.image_retries: At most 3 image reads within a 30-second request budget; short Retry-After delays respected and stops interrupt backoff
desktop.async_search: Wait for pending search requests before collecting changed results
desktop.state_writes: Bounded retries for transient Windows file locks; persistent replacement failures preserve the prior primary file
desktop.background_input: Trusted Chromium text, click and key events; actual form replay and verified file upload tested with the native app minimized
desktop.pagination: Reviewed Next/Load-more control, scrolling, page bounds and paginated gallery verification
desktop.duplicates: Partial-run history, library scope, normalized pixels and optional approximate similarity
desktop.script_invocation: Authenticated loopback HTTP API, durable request IDs and tested PowerShell client
desktop.daily_worker: real scheduled executions with injected future clocks, including deferral for a sign-in popup; no overnight endurance run
